integrity: Formal proofs of nilpotent radical reduction, exact multi-factor law, dominant exponential inversion, finite Vandermonde separation, and the sharp two-factor bound; two exact independent executable checks supplied.
scientific_limitations: The quotient must be a finite product of fields. The full ring and radical are not reconstructed. The general finite-prefix bound is sufficient and not asserted sharp. The forward field-product law follows earlier literature, and absolute priority of the inverse formulation remains uncertain.
title: Nilpotent word probabilities recover the field factors of a finite ring's semisimple quotient
